### Q18. Who developed the Self-Care Deficit Nursing Theory?

Source bank Q2.

- **A.** Sister Callista Roy
- **B.** Jean Watson
- **C.** Virginia Henderson
- **D.** Dorothea Orem

<details><summary>Answer aur explanation dekho</summary>

**Correct: D. Dorothea Orem**

<!-- job5-rationale -->

Self-care ka matlab hai apni health aur daily needs ka dhyan khud rakhna. Jaise patient apne aap naha sakta hai ya prescribed medicine manage kar sakta hai. Orem ke hisaab se jab care ki zaroorat patient ki ability se zyada ho jaati hai, toh self-care deficit hota hai. Nurse is gap ko assess karke help ya teaching deti hai.

**Option-wise explanation:**

- **A (Galat):** Roy ka model patient ke badli hui condition ke saath adjust karne ki ability par focus karta hai.
- **B (Galat):** Watson ka model caring relationship aur patient ke human experience par focus karta hai.
- **C (Galat):** Henderson ne fourteen basic needs aur independence par zor diya tha, lekin self-care deficit theory Orem ki hai.
- **D (Sahi):** Orem ne self-care, self-care deficit aur nursing systems ko ek framework mein samjhaya hai.

**Exam clue:** Jab patient apni care ki zaroorat khud poori nahi kar paata, toh Orem ki theory yaad rakho.

**Reference:** [Nursing theory or professional guidance](https://openstax.org/books/fundamentals-nursing/pages/1-5-selected-nursing-theorist)

**Related historical evidence:** [🟣 NORCET, 1 September 2020 memory-based paper](https://testbook.com/question-answer/self-care-deficit-theory-given-by--6177b3271f9fefb1556073fc). Retrieved report tests Orem attribution. Official paper/key not authenticated.

**Dedicated YouTube MCQ practice:** Specific coverage verification pending.

</details>

### Q22. Which nursing theorist emphasized environmental conditions such as ventilation, cleanliness and light in promoting healing?

Source bank Q1.

- **A.** Florence Nightingale
- **B.** Hildegard Peplau
- **C.** Dorothea Orem
- **D.** Betty Neuman

<details><summary>Answer aur explanation dekho</summary>

**Correct: A. Florence Nightingale**

<!-- job5-rationale -->

Nightingale ka maanna tha ki patient ke aas-paas ka environment recovery mein madad karta hai. Jaise gande bed linen se infection ka risk badh sakta hai aur shor se patient ki neend disturb hoti hai. Isliye nurse safai, suitable ventilation, roshni aur rest par dhyan deti hai. Aaj ke time mein current infection-control precautions aur prescribed treatment bhi zaroori hain.

**Option-wise explanation:**

- **A (Sahi):** Nightingale ki approach environment ko improve karke patient ki recovery support karti hai.
- **B (Galat):** Peplau ka focus nurse aur patient ke therapeutic relationship, yani care mein madad karne wale professional rishte, par hai.
- **C (Galat):** Orem ka focus patient ki khud care karne ki ability par hai, ventilation ya roshni par nahi.
- **D (Galat):** Neuman ka model stressors aur patient ki protective defenses ko samjhata hai.

**Exam clue:** Safai, ventilation aur roshni ko healing se jodne wala question aaye, toh Nightingale ko yaad rakho.

**Reference:** [Nursing theory or professional guidance](https://openstax.org/books/fundamentals-nursing/pages/1-5-selected-nursing-theorist)

**Related historical evidence:** [🟣 AIIMS Bhopal Nursing Officer, 23 May 2018 Shift II](https://testbook.com/question-answer/_______-is-acknowledged-to-be-the-first-nursing-th--6294c6085aa5538dce8c8494). Retrieved third-party item tests Nightingale as early nursing theorist. Official key not authenticated. Original practice, not exact PYQ.

**Dedicated YouTube MCQ practice:** Specific coverage verification pending.

</details>

### Q86. A patient can bathe the upper body but needs assistance with lower-body hygiene. Which Orem nursing system best fits?

Source bank Q3.

- **A.** Wholly compensatory system
- **B.** Supportive-educative system alone with no direct help
- **C.** Partly compensatory system
- **D.** A system unrelated to self-care

<details><summary>Answer aur explanation dekho</summary>

**Correct: C. Partly compensatory system**

<!-- job5-rationale -->

Socho patient apna face aur haath khud wash kar sakta hai, lekin pair dhone ke liye nurse ki help chahiye. Partly compensatory system mein patient aur nurse dono direct care mein hissa lete hain. Nurse utni help deti hai jitni patient ko zaroorat hai, taaki uski bachi hui ability aur independence maintain rahe.

**Option-wise explanation:**

- **A (Galat):** Wholly compensatory system mein nurse relevant self-care activities patient ke behalf par karti hai. Yahan patient kuch kaam khud kar raha hai.
- **B (Galat):** Supportive-educative system mein mainly teaching aur guidance ki zaroorat hoti hai. Is case mein direct physical help bhi chahiye.
- **C (Sahi):** Partly compensatory system mein patient kuch care khud karta hai aur nurse baaki care mein help karti hai.
- **D (Galat):** Yeh situation self-care ki need aur ability ke gap se related hai. Unrelated system is problem ko explain nahi karta.

**Exam clue:** Jab patient aur nurse dono direct care mein hissa lete hain, toh partly compensatory system choose karo.

**Reference:** [Nursing theory or professional guidance](https://www.currentnursing.com/nursing_theory/nursing_theorists.html)

**Dedicated YouTube MCQ practice:** Specific coverage verification pending.

</details>

### Q95. An independent patient needs teaching to manage a new home injection safely. Which Orem system is most appropriate when the patient can perform self-care after instruction?

Source bank Q4.

- **A.** Environmental control alone
- **B.** Partly compensatory requiring physical care by definition
- **C.** Wholly compensatory
- **D.** Supportive-educative

<details><summary>Answer aur explanation dekho</summary>

**Correct: D. Supportive-educative**

<!-- job5-rationale -->

Patient ke paas injection seekhne ki physical ability hai, lekin use abhi sahi technique aur safety checks nahi pata. Supportive-educative system mein nurse samjhati hai, demonstration deti hai aur supervised practice se check karti hai ki patient safely injection manage kar sakta hai. Agar skill ya safety concern baaki hai, toh discharge plan mein aur support arrange karna chahiye.

**Option-wise explanation:**

- **A (Galat):** Environment ko safe banana useful hai, lekin yahan main need injection ki teaching aur practice hai.
- **B (Galat):** Partly compensatory system mein nurse aur patient direct physical care share karte hain. Yahan aisi help ki zaroorat nahi batayi gayi hai.
- **C (Galat):** Wholly compensatory system mein nurse patient ke behalf par care karti hai. Is case mein patient seekhkar khud kar sakta hai.
- **D (Sahi):** Supportive-educative system fit hota hai kyunki patient instruction ke baad apni care khud kar sakta hai.

**Exam clue:** Patient capable hai aur use sikhane ki zaroorat hai, toh supportive-educative system yaad rakho.

**Reference:** [Nursing theory or professional guidance](https://www.currentnursing.com/nursing_theory/nursing_theorists.html)

**Dedicated YouTube MCQ practice:** Specific coverage verification pending.

</details>

### Q62. Which theorist is associated with fourteen basic human needs and helping patients gain independence?

Source bank Q5.

- **A.** Martha Rogers
- **B.** Hildegard Peplau
- **C.** Imogene King
- **D.** Virginia Henderson

<details><summary>Answer aur explanation dekho</summary>

**Correct: D. Virginia Henderson**

<!-- job5-rationale -->

Henderson ne nursing care ko fourteen basic human needs se joda. Jaise patient ko saans lene, khane, movement, rest aur hygiene mein help ki zaroorat ho sakti hai. Nurse strength, knowledge aur ability assess karke help deti hai, taaki patient jitna possible ho independent ban sake.

**Option-wise explanation:**

- **A (Galat):** Rogers person aur environment ko ek integrated whole ke roop mein samjhati hain.
- **B (Galat):** Peplau ka focus therapeutic relationship aur communication par hai, fourteen needs par nahi.
- **C (Galat):** King ka focus nurse aur patient ke milkar goal decide karne aur achieve karne par hai.
- **D (Sahi):** Henderson ki fourteen basic needs patient ki nursing care aur independence ko assess karne ka framework deti hain.

**Exam clue:** Fourteen basic needs aur independence ka clue Henderson se jodo.

**Reference:** [Nursing theory or professional guidance](https://openstax.org/books/fundamentals-nursing/pages/1-5-selected-nursing-theorist)

**Dedicated YouTube MCQ practice:** Specific coverage verification pending.

</details>

### Q72. During the initial meeting, a nurse and patient identify the presenting concern and establish roles. Which phase of Peplau's relationship is illustrated?

Source bank Q7.

- **A.** Termination
- **B.** Resolution after goals are achieved
- **C.** Independent evaluation without interaction
- **D.** Orientation

<details><summary>Answer aur explanation dekho</summary>

**Correct: D. Orientation**

<!-- job5-rationale -->

Orientation relationship ki shuruaat hai. Jab nurse pehli baar patient se milti hai, toh apna role batati hai, patient ki concerns sunti hai aur care ka purpose clarify karti hai. Isse trust build hota hai. Peplau ke original framework mein orientation, identification, exploitation aur resolution phases hain. Modern teaching mein beech ke phases ko working phase ke andar bhi samjhaya jaata hai.

**Option-wise explanation:**

- **A (Galat):** Termination relationship ke end ko describe karti hai, pehli meeting ko nahi.
- **B (Galat):** Resolution mein goals aur needs review hone ke baad professional relationship conclude hota hai.
- **C (Galat):** Bina patient se interaction kiye evaluation karna initial relationship establish nahi karta.
- **D (Sahi):** Orientation mein initial meeting, concerns identify karna aur roles clarify karna hota hai.

**Exam clue:** Pehli meeting aur roles clarify karne ko orientation se jodo.

**Reference:** [Nursing theory or professional guidance](https://openstax.org/books/fundamentals-nursing/pages/1-5-selected-nursing-theorist)

**Dedicated YouTube MCQ practice:** Specific coverage verification pending.

</details>

### Q99. Which nursing theory primarily emphasizes therapeutic nurse-patient interpersonal relationships?

Source bank Q6.

- **A.** Roy's adaptation model
- **B.** Peplau's theory
- **C.** Orem's self-care theory
- **D.** Nightingale's environmental theory

<details><summary>Answer aur explanation dekho</summary>

**Correct: B. Peplau's theory**

<!-- job5-rationale -->

Therapeutic relationship ka matlab hai aisa professional rishta jisme nurse trust, communication aur support se patient ko problem manage karne mein help karti hai. Peplau ke model mein nurse patient ki concerns sunti hai, milkar goals par kaam karti hai aur professional boundaries maintain karti hai. Care sirf procedure karne tak limited nahi rehti.

**Option-wise explanation:**

- **A (Galat):** Roy patient ke physical aur emotional changes ke saath adjustment par focus karti hain.
- **B (Sahi):** Peplau ka model nurse-patient relationship ko therapeutic care ka central part maanta hai.
- **C (Galat):** Orem patient ki self-care ability aur care ki need ke gap par focus karti hain.
- **D (Galat):** Nightingale patient ke environment ko recovery ke liye suitable banane par focus karti hain.

**Exam clue:** Jab question therapeutic interpersonal relationship par ho, toh Peplau ko yaad rakho.

**Reference:** [Nursing theory or professional guidance](https://openstax.org/books/fundamentals-nursing/pages/1-5-selected-nursing-theorist)

**Dedicated YouTube MCQ practice:** Specific coverage verification pending.

</details>

### Q112. Which theorist developed the Adaptation Model of nursing?

Source bank Q8.

- **A.** Lydia Hall
- **B.** Dorothy Johnson
- **C.** Faye Abdellah
- **D.** Sister Callista Roy

<details><summary>Answer aur explanation dekho</summary>

**Correct: D. Sister Callista Roy**

<!-- job5-rationale -->

Adaptation ka matlab hai badli hui condition ke saath adjust karna. Jaise stroke ke baad patient ko movement, apne baare mein soch aur ghar ke roles mein changes face karne pad sakte hain. Roy ke model mein nurse physiological needs, self-concept, role function aur relationships mein adjustment assess karke patient ko support karti hai.

**Option-wise explanation:**

- **A (Galat):** Hall ka model care, core aur cure ke three circles se associated hai.
- **B (Galat):** Johnson ka model organized behavioral patterns aur unke balance par focus karta hai.
- **C (Galat):** Abdellah ka framework twenty-one nursing problems ko organize karta hai.
- **D (Sahi):** Sister Callista Roy ke model mein patient ko changes ke saath adjust karne mein support diya jaata hai.

**Exam clue:** Adaptation aur four adaptive modes ko Roy se jodo.

**Reference:** [Nursing theory or professional guidance](https://openstax.org/books/fundamentals-nursing/pages/1-5-selected-nursing-theorist)

**Dedicated YouTube MCQ practice:** Specific coverage verification pending.

</details>

### Q26. A nurse and patient mutually agree on a mobility goal and select actions to reach it. Which theorist's central concept is especially illustrated?

Source bank Q10.

- **A.** Nightingale's environmental theory
- **B.** Rogers' science of unitary human beings
- **C.** Imogene King's Goal Attainment Theory
- **D.** Johnson's behavioral systems model

<details><summary>Answer aur explanation dekho</summary>

**Correct: C. Imogene King's Goal Attainment Theory**

<!-- job5-rationale -->

King ki theory mein nurse aur patient milkar realistic goal decide karte hain. Jaise patient bed se chair tak safely jaana chahta hai, toh nurse uske saath required help aur action plan decide karti hai. Dono ka agreed goal aur uske liye action choose karna King ke transaction aur goal attainment concept ko dikhata hai.

**Option-wise explanation:**

- **A (Galat):** Nightingale recovery ke liye suitable environment banane par focus karti hain.
- **B (Galat):** Rogers person aur environment ko integrated whole ke roop mein samjhati hain. Mutual goal setting unka main identifying feature nahi hai.
- **C (Sahi):** King ki theory mein nurse aur patient ki communication, interaction aur agreed goals central hain.
- **D (Galat):** Johnson behavioral systems aur unke balance ko samjhati hain.

**Exam clue:** Jab nurse aur patient milkar goal aur action decide karte hain, toh King ki theory yaad rakho.

**Reference:** [Nursing theory or professional guidance](https://www.currentnursing.com/nursing_theory/nursing_theorists.html)

### Q88. Which nursing model is associated with the three interrelated circles of care, core and cure?

Source bank Q12.

- **A.** Hildegard Peplau
- **B.** Sister Callista Roy
- **C.** Lydia Hall
- **D.** Virginia Henderson

<details><summary>Answer aur explanation dekho</summary>

**Correct: C. Lydia Hall**

<!-- job5-rationale -->

Lydia Hall ne nursing ko three connected circles se samjhaya. Care ka matlab body ki nursing care hai, jaise hygiene aur comfort. Core patient khud hai, jiske goals aur feelings important hain. Cure illness ke treatment ka hissa hai, jisme nurse other professionals ke saath kaam karti hai. Teenon milkar patient ki overall care ko samjhate hain.

**Option-wise explanation:**

- **A (Galat):** Peplau nurse-patient therapeutic relationship ke phases samjhati hain.
- **B (Galat):** Roy patient ki adaptation aur changes ke saath adjustment par focus karti hain.
- **C (Sahi):** Hall ke model mein care, core aur cure teen interconnected circles hain.
- **D (Galat):** Henderson fourteen basic needs aur patient independence par focus karti hain.

**Exam clue:** Care, core aur cure saath aayein, toh Lydia Hall yaad rakho.

**Reference:** [Nursing theory or professional guidance](https://www.currentnursing.com/nursing_theory/nursing_theorists.html)

**Dedicated YouTube MCQ practice:** Specific coverage verification pending.

</details>

### Q116. Which theory describes the person as an open system interacting with stressors and lines of defense?

Source bank Q9.

- **A.** Betty Neuman Systems Model
- **B.** Watson's human caring theory
- **C.** Orem's self-care deficit model
- **D.** Henderson's fourteen needs only

<details><summary>Answer aur explanation dekho</summary>

**Correct: A. Betty Neuman Systems Model**

<!-- job5-rationale -->

Neuman patient ko open system maanti hain, yani body ke andar aur bahar ke changes ka us par asar pad sakta hai. Stressors aise factors hain jo patient ki stability disturb kar sakte hain, jaise illness ya emotional stress. Model protective defenses aur resistance ko samjhata hai. Nurse prevention aur care se stressors ka impact kam karne ki koshish karti hai.

**Option-wise explanation:**

- **A (Sahi):** Neuman Systems Model mein stressors, lines of defense aur system stability central concepts hain.
- **B (Galat):** Watson caring relationship aur dignity par focus karti hain.
- **C (Galat):** Orem ka model patient ki care ki need aur self-care ability ka gap explain karta hai.
- **D (Galat):** Henderson fourteen basic needs organize karti hain. Unki theory ka identifying feature lines of defense nahi hai.

**Exam clue:** Stressors aur lines of defense ko Neuman se jodo.

**Reference:** [Nursing theory or professional guidance](https://www.currentnursing.com/nursing_theory/nursing_theorists.html)

**Dedicated YouTube MCQ practice:** Specific coverage verification pending.

</details>

### Q119. Which theorist is particularly associated with the Theory of Human Caring and carative or Caritas concepts?

Source bank Q11.

- **A.** Dorothea Orem
- **B.** Faye Abdellah
- **C.** Lydia Hall
- **D.** Jean Watson

<details><summary>Answer aur explanation dekho</summary>

**Correct: D. Jean Watson**

<!-- job5-rationale -->

Watson ki Human Caring Theory mein patient ko sirf disease ya bed number nahi maana jaata. Nurse uski feelings, dignity, values aur individual experience samajhkar caring relationship develop karti hai. Caritas concepts caring ko everyday professional actions se jodte hain, jaise dhyan se sunna aur respect dena. Caring evidence-based treatment ka replacement nahi hai.

**Option-wise explanation:**

- **A (Galat):** Orem self-care deficit aur patient ki independence ke liye help dene par focus karti hain.
- **B (Galat):** Abdellah patient-centered nursing problems identify aur manage karne ka framework deti hain.
- **C (Galat):** Hall care, core aur cure ke three circles se associated hain.
- **D (Sahi):** Jean Watson ki theory mein human caring aur Caritas concepts central hain.

**Exam clue:** Carative aur Caritas terms ko Jean Watson se jodo.

**Reference:** [Nursing theory or professional guidance](https://openstax.org/books/fundamentals-nursing/pages/1-5-selected-nursing-theorist)

### Q64. On which date is International Nurses Day observed annually?

Source bank Q15.

- **A.** December 1
- **B.** May 12
- **C.** April 7
- **D.** March 8

<details><summary>Answer aur explanation dekho</summary>

**Correct: B. May 12**

<!-- job5-rationale -->

International Nurses Day har saal 12 May ko observe kiya jaata hai. Yeh Florence Nightingale ki birth anniversary hai. Is din nursing profession ki service aur challenges ko highlight kiya jaata hai. Annual theme badal sakti hai, lekin date 12 May rehti hai.

**Option-wise explanation:**

- **A (Galat):** 1 December World AIDS Day hai, International Nurses Day nahi.
- **B (Sahi):** 12 May Nightingale ki birth anniversary hai aur ICN isi din International Nurses Day observe karta hai.
- **C (Galat):** 7 April World Health Day hai, jo broader public health issues par focus karta hai.
- **D (Galat):** 8 March International Women's Day hai, International Nurses Day nahi.

**Exam clue:** International Nurses Day ki date 12 May yaad rakho.

**Reference:** [Nursing theory or professional guidance](https://www.icn.ch/how-we-do-it/campaigns/international-nurses-day)

**Dedicated YouTube MCQ practice:** Specific coverage verification pending.

</details>

### Q66. Which historical event is closely associated with Florence Nightingale's nursing reforms?

Source bank Q14.

- **A.** Discovery of ABO blood groups
- **B.** Development of the first polio vaccine
- **C.** Discovery of penicillin
- **D.** Care of soldiers during the Crimean War

<details><summary>Answer aur explanation dekho</summary>

**Correct: D. Care of soldiers during the Crimean War**

<!-- job5-rationale -->

Crimean War ke dauran Florence Nightingale ne sick aur injured soldiers ki nursing care mein kaam kiya. Unhone sanitation, hospital conditions aur nursing organization improve karne ki importance dikhayi. Unke work aur later education reforms ka professional nursing par bada asar raha. Other staff aur public-health reforms ka contribution bhi important tha.

**Option-wise explanation:**

- **A (Galat):** ABO blood groups ki discovery Karl Landsteiner se associated hai.
- **B (Galat):** First widely used polio vaccine Jonas Salk se associated hai aur later oral vaccine Albert Sabin se. Yeh Crimean War ke reforms nahi hain.
- **C (Galat):** Penicillin ki discovery Alexander Fleming se associated hai, Nightingale ke nursing reforms se nahi.
- **D (Sahi):** Crimean War mein soldiers ki care aur hospital sanitation Nightingale ke historical work se closely related hain.

**Exam clue:** Crimean War aur sanitation reforms ko Nightingale se jodo.

**Reference:** [Nursing theory or professional guidance](https://openstax.org/books/fundamentals-nursing/pages/1-5-selected-nursing-theorist)

**Dedicated YouTube MCQ practice:** Specific coverage verification pending.

</details>

### Q94. Which organization establishes statutory educational standards for nursing qualifications in India under its governing legislation?

Source bank Q16.

- **A.** Indian Medical Association
- **B.** World Health Organization alone
- **C.** International Committee of the Red Cross
- **D.** Indian Nursing Council

<details><summary>Answer aur explanation dekho</summary>

**Correct: D. Indian Nursing Council**

<!-- job5-rationale -->

Nursing education standards ka purpose hai ki nursing courses mein required knowledge aur skills maintain hon. Indian Nursing Council Act, 1947 ke framework mein INC ko uniform training standards ka statutory role mila tha. November 2026 mein INC ki public website ab bhi educational notifications dikha rahi hai. National Nursing and Midwifery Commission Act, 2023 naya regulatory framework introduce karta hai. Current legal questions mein applicable commencement aur transition notifications verify karna zaroori hai. Listed choices mein INC correct hai.

**Option-wise explanation:**

- **A (Galat):** Indian Medical Association doctors ki professional association hai. Yeh nursing education standards establish karne wala statutory council nahi hai.
- **B (Galat):** WHO international health guidance deta hai, lekin WHO alone Indian nursing education ka statutory regulator nahi hai.
- **C (Galat):** ICRC humanitarian work karta hai. Indian nursing education standards establish karna iska statutory role nahi hai.
- **D (Sahi):** Indian Nursing Council ka statutory nursing education standards se sambandh hai. State registration aur current regulatory arrangements ko alag se samajhna chahiye.

**Exam clue:** INC Act 1947 ka role yaad rakho aur current legal position ke liye latest notifications check karo.

**Reference:** [Nursing theory or professional guidance](https://indiannursingcouncil.org/)

**Regulatory transition:** [National Nursing and Midwifery Commission Act, 2023](https://www.indiacode.nic.in/bitstream/123456789/19796/1/a2023-26.pdf). Indexed legal text notes phased commencement. Full transition notification audit pending.

### Q22. A nurse identifies a gap between routine ward practice and current research evidence. What is the appropriate evidence-based practice approach?

Source bank Q17.

- **A.** Apply a study finding without considering local context
- **B.** Combine best available evidence, clinical expertise and patient preferences
- **C.** Change practice solely on one social media post
- **D.** Ignore patient values

<details><summary>Answer aur explanation dekho</summary>

**Correct: B. Combine best available evidence, clinical expertise and patient preferences**

<!-- job5-rationale -->

Evidence-based practice ka matlab hai patient care ke decisions mein best available research, nurse ki clinical expertise aur patient ki values ko saath consider karna. Agar ward mein purani practice chal rahi hai, toh nurse reliable evidence check karti hai aur dekhti hai ki woh patient aur local setting mein apply ho sakta hai ya nahi. Change responsible team aur approved policy ke through implement karna chahiye.

**Option-wise explanation:**

- **A (Galat):** Har research finding har clinical setting mein apply nahi hoti. Patient condition, resources aur policy consider karna zaroori hai.
- **B (Sahi):** Research evidence, clinical experience aur patient preferences combine karna evidence-based practice ka core hai.
- **C (Galat):** Ek social media post ki quality aur accuracy establish nahi hoti. Sirf uske basis par care badalna unsafe ho sakta hai.
- **D (Galat):** Patient values ignore karne se care uski informed preferences ke according nahi rahegi.

**Exam clue:** Evidence-based practice ke teen parts research, clinical expertise aur patient preferences hain.

**Reference:** [Nursing theory or professional guidance](https://openstax.org/books/fundamentals-nursing/pages/15-1-evidence-based-research)

**Dedicated YouTube MCQ practice:** Specific coverage verification pending.

</details>

### Q34. Which nursing role is illustrated when a nurse communicates a patient's expressed concerns to the treatment team?

Source bank Q18.

- **A.** Financial auditor
- **B.** Equipment manufacturer
- **C.** Patient advocate
- **D.** Independent medical diagnostician in every case

<details><summary>Answer aur explanation dekho</summary>

**Correct: C. Patient advocate**

<!-- job5-rationale -->

Advocate ka matlab hai patient ki baat, rights aur needs ko respect ke saath saamne rakhna. Jaise patient treatment se worried hai aur doctor se baat karne mein hesitant hai, toh nurse appropriate permission aur confidentiality ke saath concern communicate kar sakti hai. Nurse patient ko decision mein participate karne mein help karti hai, apni preference impose nahi karti.

**Option-wise explanation:**

- **A (Galat):** Financial auditor financial records review karta hai. Clinical concerns communicate karna alag role hai.
- **B (Galat):** Equipment manufacturer medical devices banata hai. Patient ki concern represent karna iska main role nahi hai.
- **C (Sahi):** Patient advocate patient ki voice aur preferences treatment team tak pahunchane mein help karta hai. Yahan nurse wahi kar rahi hai.
- **D (Galat):** Nurse authorized scope mein assessment aur decisions leti hai. Har case mein independent medical diagnosis dena advocacy nahi hai.

**Exam clue:** Patient ki voice aur rights ko support karna nursing advocacy hai.

**Reference:** [Nursing theory or professional guidance](https://openstax.org/books/fundamentals-nursing/pages/16-2-ethics-in-nursing-practice)

**Professional guidance:** [ICN Code of Ethics revision](https://www.icn.ch/news/revised-icn-code-ethics-nurses-reflects-lessons-learned-covid-19-pandemic).

**Dedicated YouTube MCQ practice:** Specific coverage verification pending.

</details>

### Q64. Which activity is an example of continuing professional development?

Source bank Q20.

- **A.** Relying permanently on initial training
- **B.** Avoiding feedback after clinical errors
- **C.** Refusing to review new guidelines
- **D.** Participating in relevant training and updating clinical knowledge

<details><summary>Answer aur explanation dekho</summary>

**Correct: D. Participating in relevant training and updating clinical knowledge**

<!-- job5-rationale -->

Continuing professional development ya CPD ka matlab hai initial nursing training ke baad bhi knowledge aur skills update karte rehna. Jab guideline change hoti hai, toh nurse approved training attend karke recommendation samajh sakti hai aur supervised practice se skill improve kar sakti hai. Reflection aur feedback se patient care ki quality maintain hoti hai.

**Option-wise explanation:**

- **A (Galat):** Initial training foundation deti hai, lekin changing evidence aur procedures ke liye lifelong learning zaroori hai.
- **B (Galat):** Clinical error ke baad feedback avoid karne se safety improvement ka mauka miss hota hai.
- **C (Galat):** New guidelines review na karne se outdated practice continue ho sakti hai.
- **D (Sahi):** Relevant training aur updated clinical knowledge CPD ke examples hain, kyunki inse competence improve hoti hai.

**Exam clue:** CPD mein regular learning se safe professional competence maintain ki jaati hai.

**Reference:** [Nursing theory or professional guidance](https://openstax.org/books/fundamentals-nursing/pages/16-2-ethics-in-nursing-practice)

**Professional guidance:** [ICN Code of Ethics revision](https://www.icn.ch/news/revised-icn-code-ethics-nurses-reflects-lessons-learned-covid-19-pandemic).

**Dedicated YouTube MCQ practice:** Specific coverage verification pending.

</details>

### Q72. A nurse is assigned a procedure outside their competence. What is the appropriate professional action?

Source bank Q19.

- **A.** Document completion without performing it
- **B.** Ask an untrained attendant to perform it
- **C.** Perform it unsupervised to avoid appearing inexperienced
- **D.** Communicate the limitation and arrange competent supervision or assistance

<details><summary>Answer aur explanation dekho</summary>

**Correct: D. Communicate the limitation and arrange competent supervision or assistance**

<!-- job5-rationale -->

Competence ka matlab hai required knowledge, skill aur judgement ke saath procedure safely karne ki ability. Agar nurse ko assigned procedure safely karna nahi aata, toh use responsible senior ko limitation batani chahiye. Competent assistance ya authorized supervision arrange karne se patient ko safe care milti hai. Urgent care mein timely escalation karna zaroori hai.

**Option-wise explanation:**

- **A (Galat):** Bina procedure kiye completion document karna false record hai. Subsequent care galat information par based ho sakti hai.
- **B (Galat):** Untrained attendant ko procedure dene se patient safety compromise ho sakti hai. Delegation mein competence verify karna zaroori hai.
- **C (Galat):** Inexperienced dikhne ke fear se unsupervised procedure karna patient ko avoidable harm ke risk mein daalta hai.
- **D (Sahi):** Limitation communicate karke competent help lena professional accountability aur patient safety ko support karta hai.

**Exam clue:** Jab skill competence se bahar ho, toh timely help lo aur safe care arrange karo.

**Reference:** [Nursing theory or professional guidance](https://openstax.org/books/fundamentals-nursing/pages/16-2-ethics-in-nursing-practice)

**Professional guidance:** [ICN Code of Ethics revision](https://www.icn.ch/news/revised-icn-code-ethics-nurses-reflects-lessons-learned-covid-19-pandemic).

**Dedicated YouTube MCQ practice:** Specific coverage verification pending.

</details>
